verdict.rationale: Linear's Customer Requests feature shows customer use-cases directly on the issues and projects they asked for. Issues can be viewed and filtered by customer name, count, status, tier, revenue and size to find high-impact work, and customer attributes sync from Intercom. This directly puts customer context next to feedback for prioritization. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the prioritization workflow.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access customer context alongside feedback so I prioritize what really matters

citations.quote: Understand customer use-cases directly on the issues and projects they’ve asked for, or analyze feedback in bulk with Linear Agent
View and filter issues or projects by customer name, count, status, tier revenue, and size to identify high impact customer work
Customer attributes such as size and revenue can be synced with and managed from Intercom.
